Our story

Precision inevery pour.

Seeing guests light up at the first sip is why we bring the bar to you.

Nikki Nitro Coffee was founded in 2025 by bona fide coffee lovers. Several of us are engineers by trade, so we treat coffee the way we treat our work: measure carefully, keep the quality consistent and look for a better way to do it.

That mix of passion and precision became our premium nitro cold brew: hand-crafted, infused with nitrogen and poured fresh from our mobile bar, smooth and creamy in every glass.

We serve every event ourselves, and that is on purpose. Watching guests react in real time, from the cascade in the glass to the first sip, is what keeps us going.
